strings.d1.theme: Midtown: Empire State, Bryant Park, Times Square
strings.d1.s0.name: Top of the Rock
strings.d1.s0.tips: Rockefeller Center's observation deck and the best view of the Empire State Building. Timed tickets (~47 USD); clearest in the morning.
strings.d1.s1.name: St. Patrick's Cathedral
strings.d1.s1.tips: Neo-Gothic cathedral on Fifth Avenue. Free entry.
strings.d1.s2.name: Ess-a-Bagel
strings.d1.s2.tips: A proper New York bagel: everything bagel with scallion cream cheese. The queue moves fast.
strings.d1.s3.name: New York Public Library & Bryant Park
strings.d1.s3.tips: The Rose Main Reading Room is free. Take a lunch break in the park.
strings.d1.s4.name: Times Square
strings.d1.s4.tips: Best when the lights come on in the evening. Get discounted same-day Broadway tickets at TKTS.
strings.d1.b0.name: Empire State Building
strings.d1.b0.tips: The 86th floor. The classic alternative to Top of the Rock.
strings.d1.b1.name: Los Tacos No. 1 Times Square
strings.d1.b1.tips: Adobada tacos (marinated pork). The best quick bite in Times Square.
strings.d2.s0.name: Statue of Liberty Ferry Battery Park
strings.d2.s0.tips: The first Statue City Cruises ferry leaves at 08:30 (~26 USD, pedestal included). Ellis Island has an immigration museum. Book crown tickets months ahead.
strings.d2.s1.name: 9/11 Memorial
strings.d2.s1.tips: The twin tower pools. Free entry; the museum costs ~33 USD.
strings.d2.s2.name: Oculus & Westfield World Trade Center
strings.d2.s2.tips: Calatrava's white station. Great for photos.
strings.d2.s3.name: Joe's Pizza Broadway
strings.d2.s3.tips: New York slice pizza. Fold it and eat it standing up.
strings.d2.s4.name: Brooklyn Bridge
strings.d2.s4.tips: The walk from Manhattan to Brooklyn takes 30 minutes. Continue to DUMBO for sunset.
strings.d2.b0.name: Staten Island Ferry
strings.d2.b0.tips: A free ferry. See the Statue of Liberty from the water without climbing the pedestal.
strings.d2.b1.name: Eataly Downtown
strings.d2.b1.tips: An Italian food market at the World Trade Center.
strings.d3.s0.name: Central Park
strings.d3.s0.tips: In winter, look for the Wollman ice rink and a snowy Bow Bridge.
strings.d3.s1.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
strings.d3.s1.tips: The Egyptian temple, Vermeer and the American Wing. 30 USD for visitors from outside New York; allow at least 2 hours.
strings.d3.s2.name: Levain Bakery Upper West Side
strings.d3.s2.tips: Giant cookies, right by Central Park.
strings.d3.s3.name: American Museum of Natural History
strings.d3.s3.tips: Dinosaurs and the blue whale. ~28 USD for visitors from outside New York.
strings.d3.b0.name: Shake Shack Upper West Side
strings.d3.b0.tips: Burgers, as an alternative to the cookies.
strings.d3.b1.name: Guggenheim Museum
strings.d3.b1.tips: Frank Lloyd Wright's spiral. An alternative to the AMNH.
strings.d4.s0.name: DUMBO Washington Street
strings.d4.s0.tips: The classic Manhattan Bridge frame. No crowds in the morning.
strings.d4.s1.name: Brooklyn Bridge Park
strings.d4.s1.tips: A riverside park with Jane's Carousel and the Manhattan skyline.
strings.d4.s2.name: Juliana's Pizza
strings.d4.s2.tips: Coal-oven pizza in DUMBO from the original Grimaldi's pizzaiolo. Opens at 11:30.
strings.d4.s3.name: Williamsburg Bedford Avenue
strings.d4.s3.tips: Vintage shops, record stores and cafés. Take the L train.
strings.d4.s4.name: Domino Park
strings.d4.s4.tips: A riverside park on the former sugar factory site, with Manhattan views at sunset.
strings.d4.b0.name: Peter Luger Steak House
strings.d4.b0.tips: A steakhouse since 1887. Cash only; book ahead.
strings.d4.b1.name: Brooklyn Heights Promenade
strings.d4.b1.tips: A walkway with views, lined with brownstones.
strings.d5.theme: High Line, Chelsea and Greenwich Village
strings.d5.s0.name: The High Line
strings.d5.s0.tips: A park on a former railway line. Walk from Gansevoort to 34th Street; quiet in the morning.
strings.d5.s1.name: Chelsea Market
strings.d5.s1.tips: A food market in the old Nabisco factory. Try Los Tacos No. 1 and a lobster roll.
strings.d5.s2.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
strings.d5.s2.tips: American art, plus terraces with views of the High Line.
strings.d5.s3.name: Washington Square Park
strings.d5.s3.tips: The arch and street musicians, with NYU all around.
strings.d5.s4.name: Greenwich Village Walk
strings.d5.s4.tips: Bleecker Street, the Friends building and a cupcake from Magnolia Bakery.
strings.d5.b0.name: Joe's Pizza Carmine Street
strings.d5.b0.tips: The original Joe's, in the Village.
strings.d5.b1.name: Little Island
strings.d5.b1.tips: An artificial island park over the river. An alternative to the Whitney.
strings.d6.s0.name: Museum of Modern Art
strings.d6.s0.tips: Van Gogh's Starry Night and Monet. Discounted after 16:00 on Fridays.
strings.d6.s1.name: The Halal Guys 53rd Street
strings.d6.s1.tips: Chicken over rice from a street cart, with white sauce.
strings.d6.s2.name: Fifth Avenue Stores
strings.d6.s2.tips: Saks, Tiffany and the Apple Cube. Christmas windows in winter.
strings.d6.s3.name: Grand Central Terminal
strings.d6.s3.tips: The zodiac ceiling and the whispering gallery. Stop at the Oyster Bar.
strings.d6.b0.name: Katz's Delicatessen
strings.d6.b0.tips: Pastrami sandwich, on the Lower East Side.
strings.d6.b1.name: Rockefeller Center Ice Rink
strings.d6.b1.tips: Ice skating and the Christmas tree in winter.
strings.d7.theme: Lower East Side: an easy farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Russ & Daughters
strings.d7.s0.tips: Lox and bagels since 1914. A farewell breakfast.
strings.d7.s1.name: Tenement Museum
strings.d7.s1.tips: A guided tour of an immigrant tenement building. Book ahead.
strings.d7.s2.name: Little Italy Mulberry Street
strings.d7.s2.tips: Cannoli from Ferrara and the Italian neighbourhood.
strings.d7.s3.name: Chinatown Canal Street
strings.d7.s3.tips: Souvenirs and dim sum at Nom Wah Tea Parlor.
strings.d7.s4.name: Penn Station / AirTrain
strings.d7.s4.tips: AirTrain plus LIRR to JFK takes 45 minutes. Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Clinton St. Baking Company
strings.d7.b0.tips: Pancake breakfast, as an alternative to Russ & Daughters.
strings.d7.b1.name: New Museum
strings.note0: Subway: 3 USD contactless with OMNY, and free after 12 rides in a week. To JFK, take the AirTrain plus LIRR or the E train; a taxi is a flat 70 USD.
strings.note1: Museums: the Met costs 30 USD for visitors from outside New York, the AMNH 28 USD and MoMA 30 USD. Many offer "pay what you wish" on certain days.
strings.note2: Winter is 0-5°C with a chance of snow, so the plan leans towards museums. Christmas windows and ice rinks run in December; January brings sales.
strings.note3: Tip 18-22% in restaurants and 1-2 USD per drink at bars. Prices do not include tax (8.9%).
strings.note4: Bagels, slice pizza, pastrami and halal carts cost 5-15 USD; a sit-down meal is 30+ USD.
strings.note5: Book the first Statue of Liberty ferry and crown tickets months ahead; Top of the Rock is timed entry.
strings.transit.name: OMNY (contactless)
strings.transit.why_chosen: Contactless payment on subway and buses costs 3 USD per ride, and rides are free after 12 in a week
